editBoundary.generatedStatePolicy: Regenerate generated state through harness commands only; do not manually edit generated summaries.
editBoundary.outsideBoundaryPolicy: Stop and return to Planner before editing any product/runtime surface not listed here.

commandPolicy.allowedExecution: Non-destructive reads, TDD test runs, harness validation, and bounded fake-worker subprocess tests inside temporary directories.
commandPolicy.workerExecutionConstraint: Worker executor implementation must reject shell interpolation, pipes, redirects, subshells, path escapes, unapproved executables, missing timeout, secret-like output, and artifact writes outside approved roots.

rollback.strategy: Revert PKT-27 code, docs, tests, and evidence files through git if required; preserve review evidence history unless the user explicitly requests cleanup.

decision.rationale: PKT-27 requires command-execution implementation, but the approved edit boundary is explicit, destructive commands are not approved, and worker subprocess tests must use bounded fake workers rather than real credential-bearing provider sessions.
